result.reason: The clause appropriately reverses Deliverable ownership and includes a present assignment to Customer, while avoiding joint ownership and preserving Vendor Technology rights. However, the operative language does not itself grant the required perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to embedded Vendor IP or preserve Customer’s ownership of Customer Data. The margin comment’s references to §§ 13.2 and 14.3 cannot establish compliance without the relevant operative language. The redline is otherwise narrow and professionally drafted.
